en: Colorized postcard view of a historic European town with a large multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a river in the foreground. The bridge carries a road lined with buildings and towers, and behind it rises the old town with red‑tiled roofs, several defensive towers, and prominent church spires. The landscape is lush with trees along the riverbanks. At the top of the postcard, red printed text reads "Bautzen. Kronprinzenbrücke."
